title: LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4

achievements.reason: No Steam list: Steam app 21130 ("LEGO® Harry Potter: Years 1-4") is the only store-list match, but it returns an empty achievement schema and a 403 for global percentages. RAWG lists 37 achievements (with RAWG's own percentages), although its detail says 73: finishing the story levels of each of the four years and all story lessons, the house crests of each year, rescuing every student in peril, all Gold Bricks and Red Bricks, True Wizard in every level, buying the Weasley family, the Gryffindor Quidditch team and every version of Voldemort, unlocking all Animagi, the LEGO Builder tutorials, the Time-Turner, character feats, a quick Quidditch level, 100% and all trophies. These could seed an original checklist.

game.title: LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4
game.blurb: Family action-adventure from Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive and Feral Interactive, released 2010-06-03. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Family, Platformer. Chapters use the 24 level names on StrategyWiki's contents page, in groups of six, plus a chapter for the collecting goals RAWG's achievement list names.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (slug lego-harry-potter, id 447). Steam app 21130 returned no achievements (see the collectible note), so steam=None and the chapters come from StrategyWiki page names (swNames). StrategyWiki has "LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4" at completion stage 1. Written subpages: Achievements and trophies (about 6,000 characters), Walkthrough (about 5,200), Table of Contents (about 3,100) and Spells and Potions (about 1,500); Gameplay, Controls, Abilities, Characters, Extras, Cheats and all 24 level pages are linked but not written, so it was not used as a walkthrough. The chapters use its level names in contents order, from "The Magic Begins" to "The Dark Lord Returns"; the contents page also links "Bonus Level 1" ten times (one page, not written), which is left to the collecting chapter. Groups of six are our own choice: RAWG's achievements name four years of story levels, but the contents links do not say which level belongs to which year, and the summaries are only placeholders built from the page names. RAWG keeps "LEGO Harry Potter Collection" (2016-10-18) as an addition. lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4" with about 205 linked articles (mostly characters); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
